name: Astrologers
overview: Scripture clearly warns against seeking guidance from astrologers and related occult practices, identifying them as defiling and abominable (Leviticus 19:31; Revelation 21:8). The LORD commands His people not to adopt the abominations of surrounding nations, including worship of the celestial bodies like the sun, moon, and stars, which He has allotted to other peoples (Deuteronomy 4:19; 18:9). Even the wise men and astrologers of Babylon could not reveal God's sovereign secrets (Daniel 2:27), underscoring that true wisdom and revelation come solely from God.
